articles.summary: We’re excited to announce our new integration with DriveThruRPG, the largest marketplace and distribution platform for RPG publishers and fans. Now, Tabletop RPG (TTRPG) creators who launch a BackerKit crowdfunding campaign can automatically deliver digital rewards to backers the moment they pledge, reserve, or follow your campaign. For backers, this means no more waiting until […] The post From Pledge to Play: BackerKit’s DriveThruRPG Integration Instantly Delivers Digital Rewards appeared first on Crowdfunding Blog & Resources | BackerKit .
